name: Linde
description: Linde is the world's largest industrial gases company. It makes oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide and specialty gases and sells them to hospitals, chemical and energy plants, steel and mining, food and beverage, electronics and general manufacturing. It earns money three ways: 10-to-20-year on-site contracts where it builds a plant next to a big customer and sells the gas by pipeline (24% of 2025 sales), bulk liquid deliveries under 3-to-7-year contracts (30%), and cylinders sold under short contracts (35%); the remaining 11% is mostly its Engineering business, which designs and sells gas plants. About 64% of sales are outside the US. Energy is the largest cost and is passed through to customers by contract formulas, which is why sales can rise on pass-through without any change in profit.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code 2810 (Industrial Inorganic Chemicals), from EDGAR.

hq.text: Woking (UK) and Danbury (Connecticut, US), Ireland (incorporated); principal offices UK and US
hq.note: FY2025 10-K cover: Irish public limited company, principal offices Woking, Surrey and Danbury, Connecticut

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Sells gas by pipeline (on-site, long contracts), bulk liquid and cylinders; price plus volume plus energy pass-through.
businessLines.description: Industrial gases in North and South America, managed geographically.

businessLines.name: EMEA
businessLines.how: Same three supply modes; packaged gas is the biggest here.
businessLines.description: Industrial gases in Europe, Middle East and Africa.

businessLines.name: APAC
businessLines.how: On-site plants are the biggest mode here (10-20 year contracts with minimum purchase requirements per the 10-K); merchant and packaged sold alongside.

businessLines.name: Engineering
businessLines.how: One-time project revenue recognised as plants are built; not recurring.
businessLines.description: Designs and builds air separation, hydrogen, olefin and natural gas plants for third parties and for Linde's own gas business.

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Not extracted: the 10-K text read does not itemise this line (it shows $194M merchant and $1,099M other-type sales).
businessLines.description: Other businesses reported outside the four main segments; composition not itemised in the text read.
